visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and round glasses, wearing a black collared jacket over a white t-shirt, sits in front of a professional microphone. He faces the camera with an animated expression against a light-colored wall featuring a world map. (2) The scene cuts between medium shots and facial close-ups as the man speaks and gestures with his hands. He occasionally scratches his head while talking, with red and white variety text appearing on screen. (3) The man holds up a brown clipboard to simulate a tabletop and places a black smartphone on it. He demonstrates his compulsion by sliding the phone with his fingers until it is perfectly parallel to the clipboard's edge. (4) Close-up shots focus on his hands as he repeatedly adjusts the phone's alignment. Large white and yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame consistently throughout the explanation. (5) He returns to a medium shot, smiling and laughing while concluding his story. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor studio environment.

(2) A synthesized 'pop' sound effect occurs as he emphasizes the word for 'Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder,' followed by another 'pop' during the next sentence transition. (3) The vocal intensity remains consistent as he describes his habit; a subtle 'ding' sound effect accents a key point in the story. (4) The speaker's pitch rises and fluctuates more dramatically as he imitates a brief dialogue between himself and a friend. The BGM remains constant under the speech. (5) The narrative concludes with the speaker laughing lightly, his vocal tone remains bright and positive as the audio ends with a hard cut of both voice and music.
